president zik.bio: Saskatoon-born rapper, singer and songwriter President Zik grew up in Zaria, Nigeria and became a prominent voice in Nigeria’s independent hip-hop scene. His cross-border catalogue includes solo projects, work with the BHP collective and collaborations with artists and producers including Teck-Zilla, JD Era and RoQy TyRaiD.

salia joseph.bio: Salia Joseph is a Sḵwx̱wú7mesh and Snuneymuxw singer, cultural worker and language advocate from British Columbia. Alongside her work in Indigenous arts and language revitalization, she has contributed vocals to Snotty Nose Rez Kids records including M.I.N.A.Y., Broke Boy Ambitions and H.O.W. from The Average Savage.

rosette.bio: New Westminster-born Rosette Sharma, known professionally as Rosette, is a Canadian pop and dance singer-songwriter. Her career spans the Canadian edition of Popstars, independent releases and the 2012 dance hit Amnesia with Ian Carey, Timbaland and Brasco, which was certified Gold in Canada.

kim esty.bio: Canadian Eurodance singer and producer Kim Esty built a run of dance releases in the 1990s before reaching a wider audience as the featured vocalist on The Boomtang Boys’ hit singles Squeeze Toy and Pictures. Squeeze Toy topped the Canadian singles chart and won Best Dance Video at the 1999 MuchMusic Video Awards.
